```python
def test_fib4():
    # Base cases (n < 4)
    assert fib4(0) == 0, "fib4(0) should be 0"
    assert fib4(1) == 0, "fib4(1) should be 0"
    assert fib4(2) == 2, "fib4(2) should be 2"
    assert fib4(3) == 0, "fib4(3) should be 0"

    # Recursive cases: fib4(n) = fib4(n-1) + fib4(n-2) + fib4(n-3) + fib4(n-4)
    assert fib4(4) == 2, "fib4(4) should be 2"
    assert fib4(5) == 4, "fib4(5) should be 4"
    assert fib4(6) == 8, "fib4(6) should be 8"
    assert fib4(7) == 14, "fib4(7) should be 14"
    assert fib4(8) == 28, "fib4(8) should be 28"
    assert fib4(9) == 54, "fib4(9) should be 54"
    assert fib4(10) == 104, "fib4(10) should be 104"

    # Larger input to verify iterative computation
    assert fib4(11) == 200, "fib4(11) should be 200"
    assert fib4(12) == 386, "fib4(12) should be 386"
    assert fib4(15) == 2764, "fib4(15) should be 2764"

    print("All test_fib4 tests passed!")
```

```python
# Unit test for function fib4
def test_fib4():
    # Test base cases (n < 4)
    assert fib4(0) == 0
    assert fib4(1) == 0
    assert fib4(2) == 2
    assert fib4(3) == 0

    # Test computed values
    assert fib4(4) == 2   # 0 + 0 + 2 + 0
    assert fib4(5) == 4   # 0 + 2 + 0 + 2
    assert fib4(6) == 8   # 2 + 0 + 2 + 4
    assert fib4(7) == 14  # 0 + 2 + 4 + 8
    assert fib4(8) == 28  # 2 + 4 + 8 + 14

    # Test a larger value
    assert fib4(10) == 104
    assert fib4(15) == 5016

    print("All test cases passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_fib4()
```
